purpose: Curated fashion-source registry for Andy. Given Mira's editorial assignment, Andy should rank this registry and consult only the most relevant sources.

selection_guidance.instruction: Select sources dynamically from the full registry based on Mira's topic, editorial question, and keywords. Do not use fixed editorial categories.

verification.note: URLs were checked against current web results. Some official sites intentionally return subscription, bot-protection, 402, or 403 responses to automated clients; access_note flags those cases so Andy can fall back to other sources.

sources.name: Vogue
sources.description: Runway collections, designers, fashion week, street style, celebrity fashion, shopping, and major seasonal trend narratives.
sources.access_note: Public site; some content may vary by region or subscription.

sources.name: WWD
sources.description: Fashion industry reporting, runway reviews, designers, retail, business, footwear, beauty, and trend analysis.
sources.access_note: Live official site; substantial subscriber-only content and automated-access gating may occur.

sources.name: The Business of Fashion
sources.description: Fashion and luxury industry intelligence, business analysis, retail strategy, fashion week coverage, and market context.
sources.access_note: Live official site; subscription and automated-access gating may occur.

sources.name: The Impression
sources.description: Runway analysis, fashion campaigns, creative direction, seasonal aesthetics, brand imagery, and designer coverage.

sources.name: Tagwalk
sources.description: Fashion search engine for runway collections, designers, shows, looks, keywords, colors, and emerging runway patterns.
sources.access_note: Public site; some functionality may require account access.

sources.name: Harper's Bazaar
sources.description: Luxury fashion, runway, celebrity style, seasonal trends, accessories, shopping, and designer coverage.

sources.name: ELLE
sources.description: Runway, shopping, celebrity style, accessories, beauty crossovers, and accessible seasonal fashion trends.

sources.name: Who What Wear
sources.description: Shopping-led fashion trends, street style, celebrity looks, wearable styling, products, and emerging consumer trends.

sources.name: Fashionista
sources.description: Daily fashion news, designers, fashion week, trend analysis, industry developments, shopping, and career coverage.

sources.name: Dazed Fashion
sources.description: Experimental fashion, youth culture, emerging designers, subcultures, provocative styling, and avant-garde aesthetics.

sources.name: i-D

sources.name: W Magazine Fashion
sources.description: Luxury editorial fashion, designers, runway, celebrity style, red carpet, photography, and directional fashion features.

sources.name: The Cut Fashion
sources.description: Fashion criticism, cultural interpretation, street style, celebrity fashion, shopping, and trend commentary.
sources.access_note: Public site; some articles may be subscriber-only.

sources.name: GQ Style
sources.description: Menswear, tailoring, sneakers, streetwear, celebrity style, shopping, and contemporary fashion trends.

sources.name: Highsnobiety
sources.description: Streetwear, sneakers, youth culture, luxury-street crossover, collaborations, emerging labels, and cultural trends.

sources.name: Hypebeast Fashion
sources.description: Streetwear, sneakers, drops, collaborations, emerging brands, fashion news, and youth-oriented style.

sources.name: Complex Style
sources.description: Streetwear, sneakers, designers, celebrity style, collaborations, drops, and youth fashion culture.

sources.name: Footwear News
sources.description: Footwear industry news, shoe trends, sneakers, retail, designers, celebrity footwear, and market analysis.
sources.access_note: Live official site; automated-access or subscription gating may occur.

sources.name: Sneaker News

sources.name: Refinery29 Fashion

sources.name: NYLON Fashion

sources.name: InStyle Fashion
sources.description: Celebrity style, wearable fashion trends, shopping, styling advice, red carpet, and accessible wardrobe ideas.

sources.name: Marie Claire Fashion

sources.name: Glamour Fashion
